items.title: Widen the playbook.ts import-fence allowlist in experience-layer-playbook-smoke
items.context: Add ../core/source-lineage-audit.js and ../core/playbook-seed.js to BOTH allowed sets (the direct fence check and the non-vacuous planted-import check) in packages/main/src/tasks/experience-layer-playbook-smoke.ts; update the load-bearing guardrail comment in handlers/playbook.ts to match reality. Neither module is a finding-writer/advisory/gate, and the negative assertion !/finding.js$|advisory|gate/ still guards the security property. Clears checks: 'import-fence: handlers/playbook.ts imports only ...' and 'import-fence: the static scan is non-vacuous'.

happy.desc: experience-layer-playbook-smoke prints both import-fence checks as PASS (handlers/playbook.ts allowed-imports + the non-vacuous planted-import check) and the suite reaches TOTAL 31 | PASS 31 | FAIL 0.

adversarial.desc: The non-vacuous fence check still flags a planted ./finding.js import (foreign===['./finding.js']), and the negative assertion !/finding.js$|advisory|gate/ still holds — proving the allowlist widen did not neuter the scanner or weaken the security guardrail.

items.title: Fix the stale decision_doc_save authorityBoundary assertion in decision-doc-promotion-smoke
items.context: In packages/main/src/tasks/decision-doc-promotion-smoke.ts, update the expected process-event substring from 'not remote receipt completion' (retired by commit 8892270bf) to the current 'not local proof-admissibility, receipt-bundle, quorum, or release readiness'. This clears the decision-doc-promotion and experience-layer-digest-extract no-regression sub-smokes.

happy.desc: decision-doc-promotion smoke prints 'decision doc promotion smoke passed' and experience-layer-digest-extract prints 'smoke passed'; both no-regression sub-smokes inside the playbook suite PASS.

edge.desc: The decision_doc_save process-event authorityBoundary contains the current committed substring 'not local proof-admissibility, receipt-bundle, quorum, or release readiness'.
